title: 第二十一章血洗营地
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
就在张守安要出手之际，远方忽然传来一道大喊声，声音断断续续，伴随着一阵马蹄声，显然是说话者正在骑马狂奔。

    “诸位！不好了不好了，出大事了！”

    但众人没有理会这人的话语，注意力还在中间那人身上。

    毕竟这时候都要决定生死了，各个心里都紧绷成什么样了，谁还管你什么屁话。

    见众人不理他，那人有些着急，一个动作翻下马背，快跑到众人身后，然后撑着膝盖，嘴里大口喘息着：

    “干嘛呢都，听我讲啊！”他焦急地拍了两下大腿，但依旧没人理。

    好在终于有外围的人愿意搭理一下他，冲着他摆摆手：“去去去，这里忙着呢。”

    那人愣了一秒，但很快脸上出现一抹气愤，索性什么也不管，直接一股脑吐出：

    “咱们这不是要来个炉鼎吗？我今天跟宗门的同僚打听到。”

    他喘了口气，继续道：

    “人家昨天接了姜长老的两掌，还把人家的炼尸斩了。”

    他怕众人不清楚，解释道：

    “意思就是，人家练气的实力，接了筑基圆满两招，活下来了。还杀了一个筑基初期的炼尸。”

    “整个执法堂今天早上都在传，说是来咱们这的那个炉鼎，不仅杀了他们好多人，还说自己是姜长老的太上祖宗。”

    他喘了口大气，随手端起一旁的水杯，喝了起来：

    “最重要的还是，人家没事，还活下来了！”

    在场的众人瞬间鸦雀无声，只剩下了一片寂静，甚至是每人的耳边，只留下了彼此的呼吸声。

    今天要来报到的家伙，陌生人，实力强，那不就是……

    他们的视线纷纷朝中央那个黑衣男子望去，瞳孔中只剩下了震惊。

    这时，不知是谁的武器突然掉地，发出一声脆响，继而打断了这份突然来的压抑。

    突然传信男子放下水杯，不耐烦地喊道：“都愣着干什么，都动啊，收拾一下咱们这里，别惹到那个炉鼎。”

    他朝里走去，不多时，就看见了地上倒着的两人，当即一把手拍在脸上。

    “哎呦喂，你们这是闹啥啊，知道今天人家要来，还特意杀两人。”

    “怎么，放点血庆祝庆祝，欢迎一下那个炉鼎。”

    此刻，众人的视线终于落到了他身上，终于有人注意到他了。

    他因此笑了笑，但很快就意识到不对，那些人的视线看起来太瘆人了。
content_en:
Just when Zhang Shou'an was about to take action, a shout suddenly came from the distance. The sound was intermittent, accompanied by the sound of horse hooves. It was obvious that the speaker was galloping on horseback.

"Everyone! Oh no, no no, something big has happened!"

But everyone ignored this man's words, and their attention was still on the man in the middle.

After all, life and death have to be decided at this time, and everyone is so tense, who cares about your nonsense.

Seeing that everyone ignored him, the man became a little anxious. He got off his horse and ran quickly behind everyone. Then he held his knees and gasped:

"What are you doing? Listen to me!" He patted his thigh twice anxiously, but still no one paid attention.

Fortunately, someone on the periphery was finally willing to pay attention to him and waved his hand: "Go, go, it's busy here."

The man was stunned for a second, but soon a look of anger appeared on his face. He simply ignored everything and spat out:

"Aren't we going to have a cauldron? I asked my colleagues in the sect today about it."

He took a breath and continued:

"Yesterday, I took two palms from Elder Jiang and beheaded his corpse."

He was afraid that everyone would not understand, so he explained:

"It means that because of his strength in Qi training, he survived the two moves of Foundation Establishment Perfection. He also killed a corpse refining in the early stage of Foundation Establishment."

"The entire Law Enforcement Hall has been spreading rumors this morning, saying that the furnace tripod who came to our place not only killed many of them, but also claimed that he was Elder Jiang's supreme ancestor."

He took a breath, picked up the water glass on the side, and drank:

"The most important thing is that they are okay and are still alive!"

Everyone present fell silent for an instant, leaving only silence. Even in everyone's ears, only the sound of each other's breathing was left.

The guy who is going to report today is a stranger and strong, so isn’t that...

They all looked at the man in black in the center, with only shock in their pupils.

At this time, someone's weapon suddenly fell to the ground with a crisp sound, interrupting the sudden depression.

Suddenly the messenger man put down the water glass and shouted impatiently: "What are you doing standing still? Move. Clean up our place and don't mess with that furnace."

He walked inside, and not long after, he saw two people lying on the ground, and immediately slapped his hands on their faces.

"Hey, what are you doing? You knew they were coming today, and you went out of your way to kill two people."

"Why, let's celebrate with some blood and welcome the cauldron."

At this moment, everyone's eyes finally fell on him, and someone finally noticed him.

He smiled at this, but soon realized that something was wrong, the sight of those people looked too scary.
